description: This file defines the 'Config' and 'ProgressTracker' structures and associated methods for tracking the configuration and progress of nodes in a Raft consensus group, including voter and learner management, quorum calculations, and vote tallying.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents the configuration of voters and learners in a Raft group, including methods for string representation and cloning.

classes.name: ProgressTracker
classes.description: Tracks the current configuration, node progress, votes, and provides methods for quorum checks, vote tallying, and progress iteration.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Config.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Config with no shared memory.

methods.name: MakeProgressTracker
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new ProgressTracker with specified inflight and byte limits.

methods.name: ConfState
methods.description: Returns a pb.ConfState representing the current configuration.

methods.name: IsSingleton
methods.description: Checks if only one voting node exists in the current configuration.

methods.name: Committed
methods.description: Returns the largest log index known to be committed based on acknowledgments.

methods.name: Visit
methods.description: Iterates over all tracked node progresses in stable order, applying a provided function.

methods.name: QuorumActive
methods.description: Determines if the quorum of nodes is active based on recent activity.

methods.name: VoterNodes
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of voter node IDs.

methods.name: LearnerNodes
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of learner node IDs.

methods.name: ResetVotes
methods.description: Resets the vote tracking for a new election round.

methods.name: RecordVote
methods.description: Records a vote from a node for the current election.

methods.name: TallyVotes
methods.description: Counts granted and rejected votes and determines election outcome.
